newsitem.title: UK: UK Jan global trade deficit 641 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: UK Jan global trade deficit 641 mln stg.

text.p: The Office of National Statistics issued the following data on Britain's global trade in January in million stg, previously announced data in brackets

The ONS said that the erratic pattern of the deficit makes estimation of the trend difficult but the whole worlds goods deficit appeared to be narrowing. The latest estimate in the value of trade showed exports rising slightly and imports flat.
January's provisional estimates showed the volume of exports up 6.5 percent compared with December while imports rose one percent. Both were at record levels in January.

Outside the EU, growth in exports to oil exporting countries and North America was partially offset by a fall in exports to the rest of the world. The ONS said January's provisional estimates show export and import prices both fell less than 0.5 percent compared with December.

For exports, the main commodity groups changed little apart from a fall in basic materials and rise in fuels. Exports of finished manufactured capital goods jumped 3.5 percent. Exports of intermediate goods, cars and other consumer goods fell.
In value terms, the main growth in exports to EU countries came from exports to the Netherlands. This contrasted with a fall in exports to France and Germany. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7715
